prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Generate ONE isolated industrial security equipment concept-art cutout on a TRUE TRANSPARENT background. The supplied image is only a STYLE AND MATERIAL reference: match its detailed painted dark smoky Loopforge character-dossier medium, worn pale-steel armour, graphite mechanisms, restrained antique brass accents and cool lighting. Do NOT reproduce the character, sheet, background or layout. No background panel, paper backdrop, base, vignette, lettering outside the object, floating effects, gun, human or robot hand. This cutout will be composited into the blank right-side equipment slot of the approved sheet; compact readable silhouette and soft painted edges, coherent highlights from upper left. Full uncropped object with generous transparent margins, subtle hand-painted wear, credible heavy factory construction, not photoreal product photography or glossy UI icon. Subject: LIMEN's SECURITY CLIPBOARD. A broad, rugged rectangular steel inspection clipboard held nearly front-on in a mild three-quarter angle, portrait format with width 70% of height. Heavy spring clip at top, a stack of worn grey-cream worker-entry inspection papers, strong dark printed checkbox rows and a couple of red clearance stamps, a tethered metal stylus fixed along the right edge. The main paper heading reads "ENTRY CLEARANCE" in small worn lettering; no need for legible small body text. Squared chamfered steel corners, black protective edge strips, restrained brass fasteners and one tiny unlit teal status lens built into the clip. Functional bureaucratic object used to scrutinize worker papers. Preserve lots of visible paper against the metal. No screens replacing the paper. Transparent alpha all around.

baseGeneration.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit this exact existing LIMEN character concept sheet. This is a restrained colour/material revision, NOT a redesign. Preserve the original artwork's composition, all character anatomy and proportions, face, head shapes, armour construction, straps, chest labels, utility belt and pouches, poses, illustrated rendering, typography and dark smoky blue-charcoal background. Keep "LIMEN" and "SECURITY CHIEF" in exactly the same style and position. Retain the two full-body views, both head detail portraits, belt equipment and forearm energy-blade detail.

Make ONLY these changes:
1. Recolour the broad exterior ARMOUR surfaces in every character view and head detail from dark green-black steel to worn PALE STEEL, reference sRGB #AAB9BD. Preserve dark graphite recessed joints, hoses, plate gaps, strapping and undersuit so the pale outer plates read as heavy layered industrial metal. Keep original scratches, wear, material texture and carefully drawn geometry. Light steel should visibly dominate the outer shell, with convincing midtone shading, not white plastic, not bright chrome and not a washed-out image. Do not lighten the background.
2. Deepen the cyan accents in eyes and the forearm energy blade to rich saturated darker teal-cyan, reference #008FAD through #00A9C2. Keep a clearly luminous energy effect with fine electrical filaments, but reduce the broad white-hot core and pale cyan bloom so the cyan colour remains distinctly legible against the new pale armour. Preserve the exact flowing, jagged electrical blade design and attachment. No solid sword redesign. Apply consistently to all head portraits and emitter detail. Do not add cyan stripes to armour.
3. REMOVE the machine gun in the middle-right equipment area completely. Fill its former footprint seamlessly with the SAME dark smoky textured background. Do not replace it with another weapon or object. Preserve all other equipment and its layout.

Absolutely preserve this character's original heavy tactical security-chief identity. No worker head, round goggles, new riveted plates, altered jaw, new boots, shoulder enlargement, new symbols or new borders. Keep the severe skull face, angular eyes and teeth exactly as drawn. Same landscape canvas and uncropped composition. The user likes this sheet as-is; the only permitted revisions are pale steel armour, deeper cyan highlights and removal of the gun.
